title: astragalus lang-ranii
intro: Astragalus lang-ranii, commonly known as the Lang Ranii milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus lang-ranii include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
